target: Constitution section 7's list of inherited categories to audit before use: race, tribe, slave, barbarian, fort, religion, caste, civilization, invasion, indigenous.
reason: The list does not include 'demon', and 'demon' is doing exactly the work section 7 exists to catch. Grassmann's category Daemon is what sorts Sambara, Pipru, Susna, Namuci, Varcin, Vangrda, Kuyava, Cumuri and Dhuni onto the opponent side of 03-REGISTERS/rigveda-pur-fields.csv. A nineteenth-century German theological category is deciding, before any passage is read, that the holders of the forts were not people. The same lexicon glosses arya- as 'Angehoeriger der drei oberen Grosskasten', importing the later caste system into a Rigvedic word.
what_to_recheck: Whether 'demon' (and its German and Sanskrit correlates: Daemon, asura-, dasyu-, dasa-, raksas-) should be added to the section 7 audit list; and whether any register in this repository has already used the category as though it were a description rather than a classification.
status: OPEN - raised on the pur- 4J branch; the constitution is the owner's and is committed unchanged, so this is a proposal for the owner, not an edit
